quote: We evaluate annotation quality using intersection-over-union (IoU) with manually annotated spans, achieving an IoU of 69%

We evaluate annotation quality using intersection-over-union (IoU) with manually annotated spans, achieving an IoU of 69%, indicating substantial agreement (IoU > 50% is considered indicative of good agreement by DeYoung et al. ( )).

To ensure annotations reflected genuine task comprehension, we additionally evaluated accompanying natural language explanations. We found only 2 out of 30 explanations to be of low quality, further validating robustness.
